description: This file contains utility methods for handling and masking credit card numbers, including constants for card types.

classes.name: CreditCardUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to handle credit card numbers, such as masking. Includes constants for different card types.

methods.name: maskCardNumber
methods.description: Masks a credit card number by preserving the first four and last four digits and replacing the middle digits with X's.
